reviewSamples.author: Mr. Unslackable
reviewSamples.text: Love this team.  They did such a good job on my home that I’m going to make them one of our main contractors for tree removal services.  I own a solar company and it’s so hard to find good and affordable tree removal companies.

reviewSamples.author: Souriyanh Vilayvong
reviewSamples.text: Marcelo did amazing job clearing trees from our backyard. His prices were well below other companies. I highly recommend him. Thanks Marcelo!

reviewSamples.author: Maureen Cook
reviewSamples.text: Amazonia Tree Services did a wonderful job on my property. I had several large trees trimmed and cut. Marcelo is very professional and personable. I called and they came the same day.  Everyone was proficient in their particular skill and my yard looks amazing. I highly recommend them. Their service was excellent and pricing was great.
